info.title: AI·SW CAMPUS API
info.description:
AI·SW CAMPUS backend.

This API covers authentication, profile management, board posts, comments,
attachments, reports, notifications, Expo push tokens, search, events, FAQ,
and student council suggestion replies.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Login, registration verification, refresh, logout, and password reset.

tags.name: users
tags.description: My profile, password change, and account deactivation.

tags.name: posts
tags.description: Board posts, detail, pinning, likes, bookmarks, and suggestion replies.

tags.name: reports
tags.description: Post/comment reporting and admin notification creation.

tags.name: notifications
tags.description: Notification list, read state, preferences, and push tokens.

tags.name: search
tags.description: Post search and recent search keywords.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Academic and student council schedule events.

tags.name: faqs
tags.description: FAQ list and admin FAQ management.
